workLog.action: Probed the TOCTOU claim before accepting it. A spy on os.lstat proved Path.lstat() plus Path.is_symlink() issues two syscalls, and stat.S_ISLNK on the held st_mode returns the same verdict. The bot's claim held.

Replaced Path.is_symlink() with stat.S_ISLNK(entry.st_mode) so existence and entry kind come from one observation, and added the stat import.
